snippet.title: Devil Spire Falls - EA Showcase
snippet.description:
Devil Spire Falls is a procedurally generated open-world hardcore action-RPG built around dynamic and interconnected systems.

Become the town hero, delve into dungeons, explore the overworld, raze every village to the ground, live as a hunter-gatherer, or just humbly farm and fish... The possibilities are endless!

The "You Can Do Anything" role-playing experience of your dreams, as if it came out 30 years ago!

Play the free DEMO and Wishlist it at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3646460/Devil_Spire_Falls

Join our Discord community!
https://discord.gg/Hd2tESGqyE
